> Sarvam builds full-stack sovereign AI for India. APIs for speech, text, translation, and document intelligence across 10+ Indian languages.

- [Arya](https://www.sarvam.ai/products/arya.md): Enterprise AI agent platform. Build, deploy, and manage autonomous agents with full observability and zero vendor lock-in.
